BUILD REQUIREMENTS

- Windows x64 with PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe).
- .NET SDK selected by global.json: 10.0.4xx, with patch roll-forward.
- Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0 and the WinUI/XAML build tools used by Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.
- Node.js for the release-workflow contract tests.

BUILD ENTRY POINTS

- dotnet build -c Debug
- dotnet build -c Release
- dotnet test
- dotnet clean

Visual Studio is optional. Build Tools may provide the required Windows and XAML components without the IDE.
This unpackaged project does not require the 26200 Insider SDK or MSIX packaging tools.
GitHub uses windows-2025 and installs the SDK from global.json.

USER RUNTIME REQUIREMENTS

- Windows 11 24H2 (build 26100) or newer, x64.
- .NET 10 Desktop Runtime.
- Windows App SDK 1.8 runtime, installed separately as with v1.2.4.
